answer.report_md:
## 页面判断
生成器需绘制一个上下排列的双面板降序柱状图：各面板独立排序、采用不同的纵轴起点，并以竖排国家标签、水平网格、OECD average 浅蓝色带和深浅柱色表达统计显著性。数值均未印在柱上，只能按 5 个百分点的刻度插值；11、13、3、1 和 −1 尤其难精确读取。每个值至少需要“面板标题＋国家/经济体”两个键，因为两面板国家重复且顺序不同。多个柱约为 11，无法仅凭像素确定题目所指的第三个 11；此处按 Sweden 判断。

heading.title: Relationship between numeracy and individual well-being
heading.subtitle: Difference in likelihood of reporting positive outcomes (high proficiency minus low proficiency)

components.evidence: Two vertically stacked bar panels repeat the country comparison for life satisfaction and health.
A bold horizontal zero line spans both panels; Israel extends below it in Panel A.
The Israel bar in Panel A descends below the zero line.
Panel A runs from -5 to 30; Panel B runs from 0 to 30.
Lines below the panels begin “Note:” and “Source: Table A.4.11 (N) in Annex A.”
Blue banners read “A. Life satisfaction” and “B. Health” above their respective panels.
“Percentage points” appears above each y-axis while the tick labels are bare numbers.
“Percentage points” is placed above the top-left of each y-axis.
Axis labels include “Poland*” and “Denmark*”; the note begins “*Caution is required”.
All country and economy labels are rotated vertically below the bars.
Grey horizontal rules cross both plots, with no vertical grid lines.
“OECD average” is bold and backed by a pale blue vertical strip in each panel.
“Darker colours denote differences that are statistically significant at the 5% level.”

new_components.evidence: Panel A starts “Croatia, Japan”; Panel B starts “Italy, Croatia”; the note states descending order.
